content:
tara: Heads up - found a weird parity issue across SDKs when using the embeddings+rerrank helper with metadata. Seems to only trigger when vectors are 768 and we include a `meta` array per doc.

tara: Repro (Python quickstart):
```py
# quick_rerank.py (py-sdk 1.3.0)
ids = [d['id'] for d in docs]
vectors = [pad_vec(d['vec'], 768) for d in docs]
meta = [d.get('meta') for d in docs]
resp = client.rerank.batch(model='sim-embed-768', body={'ids': ids, 'vectors': vectors, 'meta': meta})
```

tara: Observed: when a retry happens the server returns scores and ids, but the client-side helper drops the `meta` association and remaps by index, so metadata ends up misaligned with top results. Customer noticed wrong snippet context in UI.

vik: Interesting - two layers: (A) old python helper flattens response into list of tuples (id, score) and zips with original meta by index; (B) on retry the runtime may reorder internal shard results and returns reordered `ids` array. If helper zips by original index meta gets attached to wrong doc.

eli: I reproduced locally with a stubbed fallback that returns reordered ids on retry. Also saw a case where pad_vec returned shorter arrays and we padded with `None` which becomes 0 on runtime and later triggers per-shard shape mismatch.

tara: Proposed fixes: 1) helper must always match response by returned `ids` and re-attach `meta` by id; 2) add strict pre-send validation: length==model_dim AND all(isinstance(x, (int,float))) AND not any(isnan/null); 3) ensure per-batch idempotency key is persisted across retries so server can detect retries and preserve ordering when possible.

vik: I'll push a small python patch: generate uuid per batch -> set `x-idempotency-key` header and persist across retry attempts. Also, change post-process to build `id->meta` map and apply to returned ordered_ids. Fallback: if response lacks ids field, then fall back to index mapping and emit a warning.

eli: For the pad_vec None issue I'll add sanitizer: replace None/NaN with explicit ValueError listing the doc id, first 6 vector values, and how many missing entries. Example message: "invalid_vector: id=user-12 expected=768 found=760 nulls=8". This helps customers quickly patch data ingestion.

python-sdk-bot: New issue created: DX-5102 (python helper: id-based mapping + idempotency), tests added to parity suite to simulate reordered ids on retry.

devex-bot: Action items: 1) implement id-based meta reattachment in python helper; 2) add pre-send vector validation middleware; 3) add parity test in node/python/rust for reordered-id retry; 4) update sampleapp quickstart to mention idempotency header when running batch workloads.

tara: Adding a tiny CI smoke test to sampleapp that bursts 50 batched rerank requests and asserts that returned ids all match expected set and that metas line up by id. If any ordering mismatch, the test fails.

vik: Short-term mitigation: set default batch retries to 1 for embed/rerank helpers and document idempotency header requirement in sampleapp READMEs.

eli: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/402 (draft) - includes idempotency persistence, id->meta reattachment, and vector validator. Assigning to @vik for review.

tara: Thanks everyone. This one explains an odd customer bug today where snippets were attached to the wrong search results. :relieved:
